subject: HealthBound security follow-up: Type II access, interim attestation, and DSQ kickoff
messages:
From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@healthbound.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: security_ops@healthbound.com, procurement@healthbound.com
Date: 2027-05-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up from demo — SOC 2 Type II and DSQ kickoff

Marcus — thanks for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and asks from our side so we can move this through the security review: 

- Can you provide a SOC 2 Type II report (redacted acceptable) and a short interim attestation / mini-attestation confirming current controls while we await the full report?
- We'll need a bridge or interim attestation that covers encryption, access controls, and data retention for our initial evaluation.
- Please initiate the vendor security questionnaire (we've attached our VSQ template) and confirm whether GDPR/HIPAA are in scope for storage/processing in your hosted offering.
- Access to your trust portal or a secure S3 link where we can pull artifacts would speed things up.

Timeline: our security committee meets next Friday; if we can get the attestation + redacted report within 3 business days that would be ideal.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if needed.

Lina Torres
Head of Security, HealthBound
lina.torres@healthbound.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@healthbound.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-16T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from demo — SOC 2 Type II and DSQ kickoff

Hi Lina — appreciated the time today and the clear asks. Short answers up front: yes, we can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and a brief interim attestation (we sometimes call this a "mini-attestation") that summarizes the control coverage. We'll also kick off your VSQ. 

Action items we will take now:
- Olga (SE) will prepare a redaction-friendly extract of the Type II and a one-page interim attestation covering encryption, access, and retention controls (target: 3 business days).
- Karthik will start the vendor DSQ intake and will share a fillable copy/portal link where you can upload answers and artifacts.
- I'll arrange trust portal access (or a presigned S3 bucket) so your team can pull the artifacts; we'll provide read-only creds and an activity log.

Questions we had from our side: can you confirm whether HealthBound requires HIPAA business associate attestation in addition to GDPR compliance details? That will determine what artifacts we prioritize. Also, let us know if a redacted PDF is acceptable or if you need a redacted PDF + CSV index of evidence.

I've attached a short PDF with our recommended redaction guidance and the VSQ template you sent (renamed for intake).

Next steps: Olga will follow up with the draft attestation, then Karthik will send the DSQ intake link. If you prefer one consolidated package, we can bundle the documents in the trust portal and notify you when everything is live.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Attachment stubs: redaction_guidance.pdf, healthbound-vsq-template.xlsx

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lina Torres <lina.torres@healthbound.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-17T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from demo — SOC 2 Type II and DSQ kickoff

Lina / Marcus — quick technical note and ETA from the security/SE side: 

- We can produce a redacted Type II (PII/identifiers removed) and a one-page interim attestation that highlights the following controls: logical access, key management, encryption-at-rest/in-transit, logging retention, and incident response.
- Delivery method: we will provision a trust-portal read-only account (you'll get a portal invite link) and optionally upload an S3 presigned bundle if you prefer direct download. Portal will include an artifacts index (CSV) to speed navigation.
- Timeline: redacted report + interim attestation by 2027-05-19 COB (ETA 48 business hours). DSQ intake link will be live by 2027-05-17 EOD.

For the GDPR/HIPAA question — our hosted API supports both, but HIPAA-specific BAA language is handled at contract stage. For the DSQ, please mark any questions that require a BAA/contractual answer and we can escalate legal in parallel.

Portal invite (will come from trust-portal@redwood.ai). If you want the S3 option instead, reply with an AWS account or we can issue a presigned download link.

— Olga
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai

Attachment stub: redaction_guidance.pdf

From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@healthbound.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, procurement@healthbound.com
Date: 2027-05-18T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from demo — SOC 2 Type II and DSQ kickoff

Thanks Marcus / Olga — that timeline works for us. A couple quick confirmations: 

- Redacted PDF + CSV index is preferred (helps our reviewers).
- The interim attestation you call a "mini-attestation" is acceptable as long as it enumerates the covered controls and the report period.
- Please send the DSQ intake link to procurement@healthbound.com and security_ops@healthbound.com. We'll start filling the VSQ; our team will flag any items that require a BAA and loop legal.

If you can target the delivery by COB 5/19 that will let our security committee review ahead of next Friday's procurement meeting. If anything slips, please ping me directly and we'll adjust the schedule.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to schedule a short sync if you anticipate any blockers.

Lina
Head of Security, HealthBound
